patch_list: Stops Dynatrace, Adobe (including its in-app marketing messages), Medallia surveys, and Firebase Analytics. Sign-in and the speed test are left alone. Opt-in; test on-device.
Stops Ookla's background reports, which measure your signal and network with your location while you are not using the app. The speed test you start still works. Experimental; test on-device.
Stops Quantum Metric, which records what you do in the app, your API traffic, and your AT&T login ID.

Stops Andi, AT&T's AI assistant, from answering, and turns off its Fusion AI features: chat history, voice to text, AI search suggestions, citations, and AI cards. In-app chat with an agent stops too, since it goes through Andi. Phone supp…
